title: Lead Magnet Document
description: The single data shape shared by every step: outline (n8n) -> section writing (n8n) -> preview and PDF (frontend templates). Content is plain text only, never HTML or Markdown; templates escape it before display.

schemaVersion.description: Bump the major number when a change would break existing templates.

meta.description: What the user typed in step 2. Kept so a section can be regenerated later with the same context.

offer.description: Optional: what the user sells after the lead magnet. Empty string = not provided. Used to tailor the title and CTA.

language.description: Language the content is written in, as a plain name (e.g. English, French, Arabic).

title.description: Must state a clear promise (what the reader gets or achieves).

sections.description: Ordered sections. Allowed types depend on the format: ebook = intro, chapter (4-7), conclusion; guide = problem, step (3-9), mistakes, next_step; checklist = group (3-5).

id.description: Stable id assigned when the outline is created (s1, s2, ...). Never reused.

goal.description: The one concrete takeaway this section delivers. Shown in the outline editor; guides the writer.

keyPoints.description: Outline bullets the writer must cover. Editable by the user before writing.

status.description: outlined = not written yet; written = blocks filled; error = last write failed.

blocks.description: Empty until the section is written.

block.description: One content block. Every block has the same three fields so the AI output can use strict structured outputs. Unused fields are an empty string or an empty array.

type.description: paragraph: text. subheading: text. bullets / steps / checklist: optional intro in text, entries in items. tip / warning / example: highlighted box, text. template: fill-in-the-blank resource; text = its title, items = its lines.

cta.description: Always present. The AI drafts heading/text/buttonLabel; the user supplies the url.

url.description: Only http(s) links are allowed, so no javascript: or data: links can end up in the PDF.

fonts.description: Must be one of the fonts the frontend offers (loaded from Google Fonts).

logoDataUrl.description: Logo uploaded by the user, kept in the browser as a data URL (never sent to n8n). Empty string = no logo. SVG is excluded because SVG files can carry scripts.

logoBadge.description: Optional. true = show the logo on a small white badge (for dark logos on colored covers). Default false: the logo keeps its transparent background.

pageSize.description: PDF page size. Optional; defaults to Letter for US/Canada browsers and A4 elsewhere.
